purpose: Teach: 身勝手/行き届い/正気/脱帽/つまっ/のぞく/使いこなす/築き上げ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、身勝手な接客はお客様に伝わるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, customers can sense when you're not fully present with them.
lines.style: Gentle observation, no accusation. Soft opening. Matter-of-fact delivery with underlying care. A mirror held up kindly, not a judgment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、店内のサービスが行き届いていて嬉しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, when you focus like that, the whole cafe feels better.
lines.style: Warm approval, genuine. Light brightness in the voice. Speaking to Aoi's effort directly. A small smile in the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、忙しさで正気を失わないようにしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Just remember — don't lose yourself when it gets hectic, okay?
lines.style: Tender concern, not preachy. Slight pause before the main clause. Steady, measured pace. The voice of someone who's noticed Aoi slipping into autopilot.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のセンスには脱帽ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way you remember what people order — that's rare, you know.
lines.style: Sincere appreciation, almost surprised by her own directness. Slight hesitation before 'rare' — realizing she's being sentimental. Genuine warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、レジが現金でつまってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though the register's jammed up with cash again.
lines.style: Wry observation, light exasperation mixed with affection. Tone shifts slightly — noticing a practical problem but not blaming. Quick, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メニューをのぞく仕草が可愛らしいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you see how that customer peeked at the menu? So endearing.
lines.style: Soft, delighted attention. Voice brightens on 'peeked.' Tender appreciation of small human moments. Like she can't help but notice the sweetness in things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新POSを使いこなすまで時間がかかるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It'll take time to get comfortable with the new system, but you will.
lines.style: Reassuring but realistic. Steady, patient tone. Not rushing her. A quiet confidence in Aoi's ability underneath the acceptance of the learning curve.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の信頼を築き上げてきたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've built something real here — the trust in this place, it's yours.
lines.style: Tender finality, like closing a gentle thought. Slower pace, deliberate. Weight on 'yours.' A moment of real acknowledgment, almost vulnerable in its sincerity.
